# Base modifiers and registers — the reference

Every class word a slide accepts without a component declaring it, by group, and every front-matter register with the groups it stamps. `lint:deck` knows exactly these words: a word in none of them is an `unknown-class`. The explanations live in [base.docs.md](./base.docs.md) and [base.registers.docs.md](./base.registers.docs.md); this page is the list.

## Which kind of word is it

| Kind | The test |
|---|---|
| component | The first `_class` word: a key of the component catalog (`kpi`, `cards-grid`). |
| variant | In this component's own `variants`; legal only after that component (`kpi spotlight`). |
| modifier | In a group of this manifest; it acts on a surface, and is offered where the component has that surface (`dark`, `rule-accent`). |
| switch | A modifier spelled `no-X` or `with-X`, X a name in lib/core/switches.mjs (`no-footer`, `with-period`). |
| register | A front-matter key (`spectrum:`, `tag:`); it stamps the words of the groups it names below on every slide. |
| universal content | Markdown the engine detects (the eyebrow, the coda, the below-note, pills, marks) and `_directive:` comments; never a class word. |
| engine class | Stamped by the engine (`lat-*`, `cat-N`, `progress-N`, `color-*`); an author never types it, and lint flags one that is typed. |

## Modifier groups

A group that **acts on** a surface is offered only after a component that has that surface (`lib/components/surfaces.js`). A group that is **not offered** is accepted but never suggested.

### Canvas — `mood`

The slide's canvas: dark or light, whatever the deck's color mode.

Acts on: the slide. Pick one.

- `dark` · `light`

### Claim — `claim`

How far the content claims the stage, from framed to the true edge.

Acts on: the slide. Pick one.

- `claim-framed` · `claim-quiet` · `claim-hero` · `claim-bleed`

### Density — `density`

Tighter spacing for a dense slide.

Acts on: the slide.

- `compact`

### Accent — `accent`

The accent-colored canvas.

Acts on: the slide.

- `accent`

### Typography — `typography`

The heading's period, and a fixed projection scale.

Acts on: `with-period` → heading, `no-period` → heading, the rest → slide.

- one of `with-period` · `no-period`
- one of `scale-l` · `scale-xl` · `scale-2xl`

Acts on: the slide. Pick one.

### Aliases — `aliases`

- `mirror` · `left` · `numbered` · `overflow` · `briefing` · `horizontal` · `banner-tag`

## Registers

A register is a front-matter key. It stamps its value as class words on every slide; a slide writes the same words to change one slide.

| Key | Stamps the words of | Note |
|---|---|---|
| `mode:` | `mode` |  |
| `venue:` | `venue` |  |
| `typography:` | `type-set` |  |
| `inline-code:` | `inline-code` |  |
| `lift:` | `lift` |  |
| `align:` | `align` |  |
| `corners:` | `corners` |  |
| `claim:` | `claim` |  |
| `fit:` | `fit` |  |
| `spectrum:` | `spectrum` |  |
| `spectrum-edge:` | `spectrum` |  |
| `spectrum-trim:` | `spectrum` |  |
| `spectrum-card:` | `card-rail` |  |
| `spectrum-card-edge:` | `card-rail` |  |
| `rule:` | `rule` |  |
| `eyebrow:` | `eyebrow` |  |
| `headline:` | `headline` |  |
| `stamp:` | `stamp-style` |  |
| `tone:` | `tone-style` |  |
| `motion:` | `motion` |  |
| `motion-style:` | `motion` |  |
| `motion-speed:` | `motion` |  |
| `backdrop:` | `backdrop` |  |
| `tag:` | `card-tag` |  |
| `agenda:` | `agenda` |  |
| `marks:` | `marks`, `marks-intensity`, `marks-source` |  |
| `logo-finish:` | `logo` |  |
| `progress-rail:` | `progress-rail` |  |
| `theme:` | — | Loads a stylesheet; it stamps no class word. |
| `size:` | — | Sets the canvas box; the engine reads it, no class word. |
| `split:` | — | Tells a `divider` how to split; the divider reads it, no class word on other slides. |
| `glossary:` | — | Lists terms the glossary layout reads; no class word. |
| `preset:` | — | Expands to the registers it bundles; it has no words of its own. |
| `color-mode:` | — | Stamps the engine's `color-*` classes, which an author never types; a slide uses `dark` or `light` (mood). |
| `finish:` | — | Stamps `finish finish-<name>`, an open vocabulary: a saved finish is any name. |
| `image-card:` | — | Stamps the image card's classes, which the image-card register owns (lib/core/resolve-image-card.js). |
| `cover:` | — | Stamps `cover-*` on title and closing slides only, which the cover register owns (lib/core/resolve-cover.js). |
| `player-motion:` | — | Read by the player, not stamped on a slide. |
| `pace:` | — | Read by the narrated guide, not stamped on a slide. |
| `delivery:` | — | Read by the narrated guide, not stamped on a slide. |

Plugins declare their own registers (`spark:`, `icon:`, `avatar:` and the image and video registers) in their manifests; their groups are listed above under the plugin's name.
